description: This file contains test cases for functions related to channel access control, including merging allow-from sources, resolving group allow lists, checking sender IDs, and utility functions. It is a test suite for the module './allow-from.js'.

methods.name: mergeDmAllowFromSources
methods.description: Merges and filters allow-from sources for direct messages, handling whitespace and empty values, with policies for allowlist and pairing.

methods.name: resolveGroupAllowFromSources
methods.description: Resolves group allow-from sources prioritizing explicit group allowlist, and falling back to direct message allowlist if specified.

methods.name: firstDefined
methods.description: Returns the first argument that is not undefined.

methods.name: isSenderIdAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a sender ID is allowed based on a set of entries, wildcard presence, and context.

ctags.name: name
ctags.pattern: /^      name: "keeps pairing-store entries for non-allowlist policies",$/
